input.text:
Sophie Powers' Spotify monthly listeners went from 604.3K to 1.3M in a week (Oct 23 to Oct 30, 2026), about 2.15x. 🔥

The reason: the 22-year-old Canadian pop singer is the new voice of Evelynn in K/DA, the virtual pop group from Riot Games' League of Legends. K/DA came back after six years with the FIRESTARTER EP (four songs, Oct 19, 2026). The new lineup adds Sophie Powers (Evelynn) and Mimi Webb to returning i-dle members Miyeon (Ahri) and Soyeon (Akali). Evelynn was previously sung by Madison Beer, and K/DA is set to perform at the League of Legends Worlds 2026 opening ceremony.

Our daily tracker had her at 623.2K on Oct 15 and 597.9K on Oct 22, so the jump is not a slow climb: 844.9K on Oct 24, 1.0M on Oct 26 and 1.3M on Oct 30.

Who is she? She went viral in 2025 with her American Idol audition (the joke original "STFU"), covered ILLIT's "jellyous" that year, and has put out 2026 singles including "klepto" with Lexie Liu and "MIA".

Can Sophie Powers hold 1M listeners once the Worlds buzz fades, or does this fall back to where it started? Tell us below. 👇

Data: Spotify monthly listeners (our daily tracker), K/DA coverage from Inven Global, GosuGamers and Destructoid · Oct 30, 2026
